tasks.story: As an admin and driver, I want distance estimation for order pricing support and external map handoff for driver navigation without building an internal map module.
acceptance: System estimates distance after pickup and delivery addresses are complete.
Distance estimation uses a realistic drivable route over public roads, not straight-line distance.
Where the selected map API supports route alternatives, the shortest drivable route by kilometers is preferred over fastest route.
Admin can manually override calculated distance.
Manual distance override is not overwritten unexpectedly when addresses are edited.
Admin can trigger Recalculate Distance or equivalent when needed.
Calculated distance supports manual price band decisions but does not hard lock pricing.
Map/distance API choice and ongoing usage costs must be confirmed before implementation.
Driver navigation uses external map apps via address handoff/deep links; no internal map module is built in V1.

tasks.story: As the project team, I want a clear rollout approach so the client can move from Excel to the new system without historical migration risk.
acceptance: System rollout starts from zero with new tours created in the system from launch date.
Historical Excel tours are not migrated into the new system.
Selected master data and drivers may be preloaded if useful.
Client may run Excel and the new system in parallel for a short period during transition.
Rollout can begin with tech-friendly drivers first.
Client prepares instructions, guides, and communication for drivers.
Phone and email fallback may remain during transition for operational safety.
CSV mass import is not part of Version 1 and remains future scope unless later requested.

tasks.story: As an admin, I want new drivers to complete a fixed number of initial jobs before they are fully released so the platform verifies reliability once, while allowing manual admin release for exceptional situations.
acceptance: Each driver record stores a probation_job_limit integer field (default 3, configurable, exact default confirmable with client) and a probation-released state; admin can read the value and release state from the driver management UI.
A driver who is not yet released is on probation: they may book up to probation_job_limit initial jobs and must have probation_job_limit jobs marked Performed before becoming fully released.

Given a driver is not yet released, when they try to book beyond their first probation_job_limit jobs before that many are Performed, the system blocks the booking and shows a clear probation-limit explanation.

Given a driver has fewer than probation_job_limit Performed jobs but has already booked their probation_job_limit initial jobs, when they try to book another job, the system still blocks until the required number of Performed jobs exists.
Given a driver reaches probation_job_limit Performed jobs, when they open marketplace booking again, the probation limit is removed and no further V1 booking limit applies.
Given an exceptional account-reset case, when admin decides the driver should not repeat probation, admin can manually release the driver from probation from the driver management UI.
There is no rolling per-calendar-day quota and no driver limit-increase request flow in Version 1; probation is a one-time release threshold.

When a driver attempts to accept a job on a day where they already have at least one other accepted or assigned job (potential same-day overlap), the system shows a confirmation prompt informing the driver; acceptance proceeds only if the driver explicitly confirms.
Same-day overlap detection uses calendar date of pickup or delivery window only — no geolocation, travel-time, or time-span optimization is required in Version 1.
Sophisticated time-span, geolocation, or travel-time-based overlap blocking is out of scope for Version 1; client will define a fuller blocking-settings model in a later version.
Probation release (automatic or manual admin release) and probation_job_limit changes are recorded in the audit log.
Probation enforcement is applied server-side so a driver cannot bypass it through parallel requests.

Probation blocks only driver self-service marketplace booking. Admin direct assignment is not limited by probation: admin may directly assign additional jobs to a driver even while that driver is on probation (decision 2026-07-10).
Performed jobs count toward the probation release threshold regardless of whether the driver self-accepted them or an admin directly assigned them.

The driver-facing presentation is a probation-specific status/progress card; the legacy daily-limit usage meter and the 'request higher limit' action are removed (F-02, replaces the earlier limit-request UI).

tasks.story: As an admin, I want to configure operational rules such as cancellation cutoffs and message requirements without redeploying the application.
acceptance: Operational policies are stored in app_settings under key operational.policies as JSON (adminCancelMinHoursBeforePickupStart, scheduleChangeMinHoursBeforePickupStart, referenceTime pickup_window_start, allowPolicyOverrideWithAuditNote).
Cancellation policies are stored under cancellation.policies (adminCancelRequiresReasonCode, adminCancelRequiresDriverMessage, adminCancelDriverMessageMinChars, driverCancelExplanationMinChars).
Admin Settings UI exposes current values with validation (non-negative hours, minimum message lengths >= 1).
Cancel job and revert-to-draft or committed schedule edit flows read policies server-side (production) or from store settings (prototype) and return a clear error when inside cutoff window.
Policy changes write an audit event with previous and new values.
Default driver probation job count may be stored under driver.acceptance.probationJobCount (default 3, confirmable with client); this replaces the former driver.acceptance.defaultDailyJobLimit key.
Branding display name remains under branding.display app setting aligned with resolved_defaults.app_display_name.

tasks.story: As a service partner or Autheon admin, I want clearly separated processes for cancelling an order, reporting an empty run, reviewing an empty-run report, cancelling from the backend, editing active orders, duplicating orders, and full audit logging — so contractual cancellations and non-executable orders are handled correctly and traceably. Source of truth for German copy: Storno-Workflow-1.pdf (2026-07-21). Refines tasks 12/13/14 for the service-partner split.
acceptance: §1 Entry: on an already-booked order the service partner sees a warning/action button using the ⚠ symbol; selecting it opens a dialog/bottom-sheet with two options — Cancel order and Report empty run — that start SEPARATE workflows and must not share a resulting status or backend action.

§2 SP cancel: a warning dialog first states the order is contractually booked and cancellation costs up to the agreed remuneration may apply, with a link to the applicable terms/contractual conditions; actions Cancel and Continue cancellation.

§2.1 SP cancel input: exactly one reason required (Appointment cannot be met · Order booked accidentally · Execution is organisationally impossible · Other); a written explanation of at least 30 characters is mandatory; the final action is a slide-to-confirm labelled 'Auftrag stornieren'.

§2.2 SP cancel result: status Cancelled by service partner; order read-only; removed from the partner's active orders but kept in history; admin backend informed immediately; store reason, explanation, date, time, executing partner; recorded in audit log; NOT auto-republished; cancellation fees NOT processed in-system.
§2.3 SP cancel confirmation: show 'Auftrag storniert' / 'Der Auftrag wurde erfolgreich storniert und darf nicht mehr durchgeführt werden.'

§3 Empty run: an empty run means the ORDER cannot be executed (not a personal inability of the driver). Required reason (Vehicle technically not operational · not roadworthy · not present/not found at the location · not being released · key or required documents missing · Other).
§3.2 Empty run input: description of at least 30 characters; OPTIONAL photo/evidence upload that must never be required to submit.

§3.3 Empty run warning: before submission, explain Autheon will review the report, submitting does not automatically establish entitlement to recognition/payment, and advise phoning dispatch where possible; submit labelled 'Leerfahrt melden' (slide-to-confirm).

§3.4 Empty run result: status Empty run reported; partner cannot edit the submitted report; admin backend informed immediately; store reason, description, date, time, partner, any evidence; recorded in audit log; further partner processing prevented while review is pending.
§3.5 Empty run confirmation: show 'Leerfahrt gemeldet' / 'Ihre Meldung wurde an Autheon übermittelt und wird geprüft.'
§4 Admin review: orders with status Empty run reported appear in the backend as open review cases; the admin has exactly two decisions — Recognised / Not recognised — with no intermediate statuses.

§4.1 Recognised: status Empty run recognised; completed; read-only; push + in-app notification to the partner ('Leerfahrt anerkannt · Die gemeldete Leerfahrt für den Auftrag {tour} wurde durch Autheon anerkannt.').
§4.2 Not recognised: status Empty run not recognised; completed; read-only; push + in-app notification; does NOT reactivate the original order.

§5 Admin cancellation: admins can cancel unbooked and already-booked orders. §5.1 Unbooked: removed immediately from the marketplace, booking prevented, fully visible in the backend, status Cancelled by Autheon, read-only, audit-logged, never deleted. §5.2 Already booked: status Cancelled by Autheon, read-only, removed from the partner's active orders but kept in history, push + in-app notification to the partner ('Auftrag durch Autheon storniert · Der Auftrag {tour} wurde durch Autheon storniert und muss nicht mehr durchgeführt werden.'), audit-logged.

§6 Internal notes: every order in the backend has a general internal-note function visible to admins only, never shown in the service-partner frontend; optional; auto-stores the authoring admin's name + date/time; permanently attached to the order.

§7 Editing active orders: admins may edit all order data while the order is not cancelled/completed, including orders already booked by a partner. After save: persist immediately; push + in-app notification to the assigned partner including the actual changed values where possible; no partner re-confirmation required; store previous AND new values in the audit log; combine multiple simultaneous changes into one notification.

§8 Cancelled/completed behaviour: cancelled orders stay permanently cancelled — no reactivation, further editing, reset to a previous status, or direct republication; the order stays visible in the backend and in the affected partner's history.

§9 Duplicate order: reuse an existing/cancelled order via Duplicate order, primarily from the order's three-dot menu (right-click optional). It creates a new draft copying all data, generates a new order number, opens the new draft in the editing view, allows editing all copied data, is not shown in the marketplace until the admin explicitly Publishes, and leaves the original unchanged. No visible 'duplicated from' reference required.

§10 ⚠ availability: hide/disable the ⚠ action when status is Cancelled by service partner, Cancelled by Autheon, Empty run recognised, Empty run not recognised, Performed, or Completed; and for Empty run reported the partner cannot submit another cancellation or empty-run report while the admin decision is pending.

§11 Audit log: record at minimum SP cancellation, Autheon cancellation, empty-run report submission, empty-run recognition, empty-run rejection, subsequent order-data changes (previous + new values), order duplication, and publication of a duplicated order; each entry has acting user, timestamp, affected order, and relevant details.

Guard rails: SP cancellation and empty-run workflows are technically and status-wise separate; required reason + minimum text length validated before submission; final submissions cannot be triggered accidentally (slide-to-confirm); orders become read-only in all specified final states; concurrent/repeated submissions cannot create duplicate status changes, notifications, or audit-log entries; flows work on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Status model: implemented as an extended enum (see client_status_mapping.status_model_decision_task2) with board umbrella grouping + reason chip.

Prototype note: backend behaviour (persistence, real push, permissions, admin review side-effects) is simulated via the existing mocks; the ⚠ entry reuses the driver Report Problem sheet; the prototype now implements the FULL editable-booked-order form: admins edit any non-terminal order (including already-booked ones) through the same canonical Create/Edit Job form (NewOrder) used for job creation, saved via store.updateOrderFromForm — it persists immediately, notifies the assigned partner with the actual driver-visible changed values (internal notes and admin-only financials never leak), audits previous→new per changed field, preserves the operational status, and requires no partner re-confirmation. Backend persistence/permissions remain simulated via the existing mocks.
Open item: the cancellation-warning terms link is a placeholder pending the real Terms & Conditions target (see production_open_questions).

out_of_scope: Chat / messaging between admin and drivers
GPS tracking, live tracking, or real-time driver location
Internal custom map module; Version 1 only hands addresses to external map apps
Driver rating/ranking
Automated driver-job matching
Full Finance dashboard and advanced finance analytics unless separately confirmed
Advanced BI dashboards and margin automation beyond basic recorded fields
Accounting/invoicing system integration; export/download and manual bookkeeping upload remain in scope where specified
Vehicle condition documentation or protocol app integration, including thousands of images and plausibility checks
Historical Excel tour migration into the new system
CSV mass import for customers, addresses, tours, or other large datasets in Version 1
Native support for complex A to B to A or A to B to C tour chains; these are represented as separate A to B orders for now
Rich newsletter editor, replies, attachments, or advanced formatting for News; Version 1 news is short one-way text
Full backend notification center unless the chosen platform makes it trivial; Version 1 may use admin email alerts
Full product multilingual/i18n rollout and localized legal copy management unless separately scoped; demo locales may exist in prototype only
External customer import interfaces or PDF recognition unless separately scoped
Any behavior not described in PRD v1.5, validated wireframes, client feedback, or approved change request
Credit-note generation or credit-note workflow in V1 unless separately approved.
Scanner or AI-based document quality scoring, OCR validation, or automated document acceptance in V1.
Partner Policy / driver terms content management when legal terms stay as external static content; V1 may deep-link to the approved external policy.

resolved_defaults.documents_module_production: Optional/costed line item; prototype includes full module enabled.
resolved_defaults.document_rejection_ux: Correction required badge on performed tours in My Jobs only; driver can replace rejected or uploaded driver_pwa files; admin_off_channel and transport-order docs are read-only for drivers; admin may replace dispatch documents; no separate correction queue in V1.
resolved_defaults.map_distance_production: Technical spike required; prefer shortest drivable route by km when API supports route alternatives.
resolved_defaults.driver_auth_production: Keycloak selected for authentication. AUTHEON links users to Keycloak via keycloak_id; exact realm/client setup and driver login ceremony remain implementation configuration.
resolved_defaults.admin_email_alerts_v1: Global dispatcher mailbox list; per-event configuration deferred.
resolved_defaults.blocked_inactive_history: Inactive and archived: read-only historical tours; blocked: no marketplace actions, read-only history.
resolved_defaults.pdf_generation_timing: On acceptance or direct assignment, not on publish.
resolved_defaults.push_on_direct_assign: 2026-07-30: SUPERSEDED — direct assignment now triggers a driver in-app notification (job_assigned). Previously false.
resolved_defaults.pdf_tax: Amounts as entered; no automated VAT until legal confirms.
resolved_defaults.vehicle_categories_v1: SUPERSEDED 2026-07-26 by resolved_defaults.vehicle_domain_v2 + vehicle_approved_values_only_v1. The former five-value list (PKW, SUV, Transporter, Oldtimer, LKW < 3,5t) is replaced by exactly three approved values: passenger_car, truck_up_to_7_5_t, truck_over_7_5_t. The removed values are no longer storable.
resolved_defaults.vehicle_csv_role: Glossary/reference only; not operational import data.
resolved_defaults.vehicle_important_info_v1: SUPERSEDED 2026-07-26 by resolved_defaults.vehicle_domain_v2 (client confirmation 'Systemlogik Fahrzeugeingabe'). Historical position (2026-07-14, Design Direction Board July 2026 section 5): jobs carried optional important-vehicle-info metadata - vehicle_registration_status (registered | deregistered, nullable), electric_vehicle boolean, red_license_plates boolean and red_license_plate_number varchar(32); the licence plate was hidden and cleared when deregistered and a red-plate number was required when the red-plates flag was set. The manual red-plates flag and the red-plate number are now REMOVED and the plate-clearing rule is REVERSED.
resolved_defaults.app_display_name: Configurable; default Transport Portal until client provides final name.
resolved_defaults.audit_log_language_v1: English action keys; UI localized EN/DE.
resolved_defaults.driver_master_edits: Admins may edit all fields; audit status changes, access reset, block, archive.
resolved_defaults.camera_and_document_helpers: Explicit upload-source choice in V1: the upload control opens an action sheet with Foto aufnehmen (camera capture, images only, rear camera preferred via capture="environment") and Datei auswaehlen (normal OS file picker, application/pdf + the supported image MIME types, no capture attribute). Per-type helper notices remain in the prototype. The camera is never opened by the generic upload action.
resolved_defaults.report_problem_ui: Primary footer label Report problem / Problem melden with warning-style icon.
resolved_defaults.admin_new_job_entry: Primary CTA on Jobs overview only; no separate New job item in admin sidebar navigation.
resolved_defaults.customer_input_v1: Required select from customer master data; free-text customer field not used for production create form.
resolved_defaults.direct_assign_and_reassign_v1: Assign from Draft and reassign on Assigned/Accepted/empty-run reported require picking an active driver; reassignment preserves status.
resolved_defaults.admin_notification_feed_v1: Lightweight in-admin event list for critical events; complements email alerts; not a full notification center.
resolved_defaults.account_provisioning_v1: Prototype-generated temporary passwords are demo-only. In production, public /v1/users self-registration is removed; admins create driver/admin accounts and resend access from the admin UI, but credentials are delivered through Keycloak required-action/invite emails so users set their own passwords. AUTHEON does not expose generated passwords in the UI or store them in the application database.
resolved_defaults.production_roles_v1: Use Keycloak/application roles admin and driver. Driver workflows must resolve the local driver profile from the authenticated Keycloak subject server-side; clients must not submit or spoof driverId for self-actions.
resolved_defaults.backend_schema_strategy_v1: Backend schema changes follow existing TypeORM entity synchronization for now; explicit database migrations are deferred and must be planned before production hardening with DB_SYNCHRONIZE=false.
resolved_defaults.backend_finance_boundary_v1: Only basic job financial fields are implemented and must be feature-gated. Full Finance dashboard and advanced finance analytics remain future scope unless separately approved.
resolved_defaults.backend_notification_routing_v1: Backend notification routing follows notification_channels_matrix. Critical business events are routed to admin feed/email or driver in-app/push as specified; technical account sync and non-critical CRUD events remain audit/outbox records only.
resolved_defaults.document_review_checked_step: Optional admin mark-as-checked before accept/reject when operations require it.
resolved_defaults.client_display_status_labels: UI may show Under review and Completed from document_review_summary and settlement Closed without adding operational statuses.
resolved_defaults.master_data_change_request_v1: Driver request queue; one open per driver; admin Approve & save applies updateDriver; Reject without save; audit master_data_change_requested|approved|rejected; driver in-app notify on resolution.
resolved_defaults.report_problem_cancel_ux_v1: Binding warning + driver terms link before slide; warning icon on tour detail and sheet header. SUPERSEDED for the driver flow by Task 32 (v2.4, Storno): the ⚠ entry now splits into SP Cancel order (4 reasons, ≥30-char explanation → cancelled_by_sp) and Report empty run (6 reasons → empty_run_reported); the seven reason codes remain the ADMIN/legacy cancellation set, and the ≥30-char minimum supersedes the old 10-character slide gate.
resolved_defaults.empty_run_evidence_v1: Optional file upload (PDF/images, capped in prototype) attached to the empty-run report (empty_run_reported); never required to submit; listed on the admin empty-run review panel; reviewed via Recognised / Not recognised; metadata only in demo.
resolved_defaults.driver_probation_acceptance_limit_v1: One-time probation model (F-01, replaces the former per-calendar-day daily_job_limit model). Each driver stores a probation_job_limit (smallint, default 3, confirmable with client) and a probation-released state (probation_cleared_at). A driver on probation may book up to probation_job_limit initial jobs and must have that many jobs marked Performed to be released; after release no further V1 booking limit applies. resolved_defaults.vehicle_domain_v2: Resolved 2026-07-26 via the client confirmation document 'Systemlogik Fahrzeugeingabe.pdf'. The vehicle domain is FOUR EXPLICIT CATEGORIES with distinct cardinalities plus independent characteristics - the earlier proposal to flatten every vehicle classification into one unstructured multi-select tag collection is REJECTED/SUPERSEDED. (1) vehicle_type: exactly one of passenger_car (PKW) | truck_up_to_7_5_t (LKW bis einschliesslich 7,5 t) | truck_over_7_5_t (LKW ueber 7,5 t). SUV, Van/Transporter and Classic car/Oldtimer are removed entirely and are not storable - rejected server-side on create and update. (2) vehicle data: manufacturer chosen from the existing manufacturer catalogue via dropdown, model as a separate field, official licence plate of the transported vehicle as a separate field, VIN validated as EXACTLY 17 characters. (3) transport_type: exactly one of own_axle (Eigenachse) | third_party_axle (Fremdachse) - renames the former axle concept across UI, i18n keys, DTOs, docs, schema and tests, with the legacy axle field mapped at the API boundary as a deprecated read-only alias. (4) vehicle_registration_status: exactly one of registered (Zugelassen) | deregistered (Abgemeldet), INDEPENDENT of transport_type and never inferred from it. (5) additional characteristics: electric_vehicle (E-Fahrzeug) and ready_to_drive (Fahrbereit) as independent booleans; ready_to_drive is decision-relevant for third-party-axle transport, is not mandatory, and is never auto-cleared. The official licence plate remains required while registered and optional-but-enterable once deregistered (a previous or de-stamped plate may be recorded); it is never disabled, hidden, cleared or replaced by a red-plate field. Manual red-licence-plate selection and red-licence-plate NUMBER capture are removed entirely - red plates are brought independently by the executing service partner and the number is not recorded. requiresRedLicencePlates is a DERIVED read-only property computed by ONE canonical backend domain policy as (registration_status = deregistered AND transport_type = own_axle); it is never manually selected, never a writable field and is not persisted. The canonical German notice 'Rote Kennzeichen erforderlich' is served through i18n and must appear in exactly five surfaces: Admin Backend, marketplace order card, marketplace preview, booking dialog (clearly highlighted) and the complete order view after booking - remaining visible after booking because it is an execution requirement. Registration status and both characteristics are shown to the service partner in the complete order view. No runtime admin UI for managing vehicle classifications is in scope for this phase; approved values are maintained through the repository's seed/configuration conventions.
resolved_defaults.vehicle_approved_values_only_v1: Resolved 2026-07-26. The three approved vehicle types are the COMPLETE and EXCLUSIVE set - there is NO legacy/compatibility layer. SUV, Van/Transporter, Classic car/Oldtimer and the older 'Light truck <3.5t' / 'LKW < 3,5t' band are not storable: jobs.vehicle_type is the vehicle_type ENUM, the application rejects any non-approved value server-side on BOTH create and update, and no per-record escape hatch exists while editing. There is no '(legacy)' display template, no neutral fallback icon, and no isLegacyVehicleType / LEGACY_VEHICLE_TYPES concept in the domain, UI, filters or notification preferences. vehicle_registration_status is NOT NULL - there is no 'not specified' state. The retired red-plate fields (red_license_plates, red_license_plate_number) are dropped outright with no audit/history column retained, and the pre-rename job.vehicle / job.axle field names are gone with no deprecated read-only aliases. PRODUCTION MIGRATION BLOCKERS (see docs/database/logical-model.md 'Migration notes (backend)'): existing rows holding a removed vehicle type have no approved target value, and rows with a null registration status have no approved default (guessing one would fabricate a red-plate decision) - both require explicit client approval before the enum cast and the NOT NULL constraint can be applied. No destructive migration is written until then.
resolved_defaults.document_upload_source_selection_v1: Every Driver PWA document-upload entry point (tour-completion success modal, tour-detail Tour documents card, performed-tour My documents tab) routes through one shared UploadSourcePicker: document type is chosen first, then the source. Take photo -> hidden input with accept limited to the supported image types + capture="environment". Choose file -> hidden input with accept="application/pdf" plus the supported image MIME/extension list and no capture attribute. Accepted types stay aligned front-to-back: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif. Single-file selection is preserved (no multiple attribute). Cancelling either step is a no-op.
resolved_defaults.document_upload_max_file_size_v1: 25 MB per file, applied identically to captured photos, existing images and PDFs. Enforced on every upload path (driver add, driver replace, admin attach/register, empty-run evidence) and surfaced through the existing inline error UI; the displayed hint and the enforced limit must not drift apart. Client-side validation is never the only protection - the server rejects oversized and unsupported files independently.
resolved_defaults.driver_content_access_audit_v1: Driver PWA content access is audited inside the existing request flows, one append-only entry per interaction, never merged: document_viewed / document_downloaded (Infopoint general documents), tour_document_viewed / tour_document_downloaded (tour documents), pdf_viewed / pdf_downloaded (transport-order PDF), notification_viewed (one per notification carried by a notifications-list request), news_item_viewed (every opening of an Infopoint message, including an already-read one). Action keys are stable English and follow the audit log's <entity>_<past-tense-verb> convention. Every entry carries the acting driver + driver id, entity type + stable entity id, timestamp, actionType ('viewed' | 'downloaded'), the document version where one exists, and job/tour when the content belongs to a tour. Reuses production audit_events unchanged - actionType and version live in metadata, not in new columns. Marking a notification read and marking an Infopoint message read are separate facts and are not themselves views. Unknown, hidden or unauthorized targets fail safely and audit nothing.

client_feedback_resolved.resolution: Probation limits only driver self-service marketplace booking. Admin direct assignment is exempt: admin may directly assign additional jobs to a driver even while the driver is on probation. Performed jobs count toward the probation release threshold regardless of whether they were self-accepted or admin-assigned.

client_feedback_resolved.question: How should permitted documents be presented to drivers in the PWA? (Post-v1.8 meeting, F-03)
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: Prefer previewing permitted PDFs/images inside the PWA over forcing a separate browser tab. Download remains available; share/print actions are exposed through standard device/system APIs where the platform supports them.

client_feedback_resolved.question: Can admin upload additional documents manually while creating the job, beside the generated one, or even replace it? (Ferhat Q&A 2026-06-29, Q4)
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: Yes. Admin may attach additional self-created documents at job creation or editing, including optional images. These are stored alongside or as a substitute for the auto-generated transport-order document.

client_feedback_resolved.question: Shall we let admin add lat/long coordinates of an address for more accurate locations? (Ferhat Q&A 2026-06-29, Q5)
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: No for V1. Geocoding and manual lat/long entry are deferred to a future version and kept in mind for future scope.

client_feedback_resolved.question: When admin cancels an assigned tour, must the driver receive an explanation? (Product decision 2026-07-02)
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: Yes. Admin cancel requires reason code plus driver-facing message (cancellation_reason_text). Shown on cancelled tour detail and in order_cancelled_by_autheon notification.

client_feedback_resolved.question: Should admin-configurable rules block cancel or schedule change within X hours of pickup? (Product decision 2026-07-02)
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: Yes for V1 via app_settings operational.policies. Default 1 hour before pickup window start for admin cancel and schedule change; exact values TBD with client. Optional override with audit note when enabled.

client_feedback_resolved.question: Is credit-note generation part of V1? (Meeting 2026-06-29)
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: No. Treat as future scope / roadmap item unless the client separately approves it for V1.

client_feedback_resolved.question: Are scanner / AI document quality checks part of V1? (Meetings 2026-06-25/2026-06-29)
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: No. V1 supports file malware scanning and manual admin document review; automated OCR/AI document-quality validation is future scope.

client_feedback_resolved.question: Do order-specific notes automatically inherit customer/address master-data notes?
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: No. Master-data notes are reference data. Order-specific internal or driver-visible notes must be explicitly applied or entered for the tour.

client_feedback_resolved.question: How should postal-prefix marketplace filtering work? (Meeting 2026-06-25 Decision 9)
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: Broader German postal prefixes are inclusive of narrower prefixes; e.g. prefix 4 matches 40 and 41.

client_feedback_resolved.question: Where are Partner Policy / driver terms managed in V1?
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: If the approved terms remain external static content, V1 links to that external policy instead of building legal content management.

client_feedback_resolved.question: Can the driver switch between the tabs by swiping (e.g. in My Jobs and Infopoint), like a native mobile app?
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: Yes (Figma-comment feedback, PR #17 2026-07-23). My Jobs (Active/Performed/Cancelled/Special) and Infopoint (Documents/News/Help) render their tab bodies as a horizontal paged carousel (SwipeViews): a horizontal drag pages between tabs with the adjacent pane peeking in and snapping on release, while each pane keeps its own vertical scroll. Tapping the tab pills still works. UI/UX only — no schema or business-rule change.

client_feedback_resolved.question: Is the marketplace header KPI info bar (Available / Booked / Open documents) needed?
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: No — removed at client request (Figma-comment feedback, PR #17 2026-07-23). The same counts already appear as tab badges under My Jobs, so the marketplace row only duplicated them. The .kpi-row/.kpi-chip CSS and kpiAvailableJobs/kpiBookedJobs/kpiOpenDocuments i18n keys remain but are unused; re-introduce only on explicit client ask. DDB marks header KPIs as 'may contain', so absence stays compliant.

client_feedback_resolved.question: Should numeric fields accept digits only?
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: Yes (bug report, PR #17 2026-07-23). Digits-only on input for: driver preferred pickup-postal prefix, Marketplace filter PLZ (pickup + delivery), and admin Create/Edit-Job postal code, house number and distance (both pickup + delivery where applicable). Phone and second phone allow a single leading '+' for the country code then digits; driver offer (EUR) allows digits plus one decimal separator; alternate contact person stays free text because it stores a name.

client_feedback_resolved.question: The upload area opens the camera immediately - how does a service partner attach an invoice PDF already saved on the phone?
client_feedback_resolved.resolution: The generic upload control no longer opens the camera. After picking the document type the driver gets an explicit source action sheet: Foto aufnehmen (camera capture, images only) or Datei auswaehlen (normal OS file picker with PDF and the supported image types). Existing upload, validation, error, replace and removal behaviour is unchanged, and the 25 MB maximum now applies to photos, images and PDFs alike.
